subject.title: [Feature]: Prefer Volta shim path over version-pinned Volta node path for macOS gateway LaunchAgent

question: Should OpenClaw support `~/.volta/bin/node` as the managed macOS LaunchAgent fallback when `process.execPath` is a Volta tools/image Node path and no supported system/Homebrew Node is selected?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but accepting it changes managed-service runtime policy from warning against version-manager paths toward supporting a specific Volta shim fallback.

options.title: Review a proof-backed Volta fallback
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a refreshed candidate PR to prove an actual macOS LaunchAgent install or reinstall under Volta before accepting the policy change.

options.title: Reject Volta service shim fallback
options.body: Keep the current system-Node policy, document Volta-managed service runtimes as warned or unsupported, and close this issue after that maintainer decision.

options.title: Accept helper-only normalization
options.body: Land the narrow resolver/test change without changing broader runtime policy, while owning the risk that Volta shims may behave differently under launchd.

recommendation.title: Review a proof-backed Volta fallback
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a refreshed candidate PR to prove an actual macOS LaunchAgent install or reinstall under Volta before accepting the policy change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the current runtime-selection and adjacent Homebrew stable-node history, and the remaining blocker is product/runtime policy rather than implementation mechanics.
